rows.name: All 42 canonical voicings sound only their actual open/fretted strings at the correct pitch
Slowing the strum changes timing without changing pitch, order or muted-string exclusion
Invalid note spellings and unsupported rates cannot schedule sound
One voice per sounding string, bounded level envelope and tempo schedule
Stop cancels future strums and a stale ended event cannot stop a replacement chord
A pending iPad unlock superseded by stop cannot start stale chord audio
Unmount/dispose closes its audio context once and prevents future playback
